title: refactor(types,plugin-designer,i18n)!: retire the unread designer members objectui#11434's ruling settles as RETIRE, on both faces (PR 1 of 3)
body:
Part of #11434

Clause-②: yes

PR 1 of at most 3 for objectui#11434: **every retirement** the seat ruling on that card settles (ruling comment `5946170549`, option B). The members ruled READ are not touched here and ship in PR 2 and PR 3. So is the `onDelete` → `deleteBehavior` respelling. The final PR of the card says it completes the card; this one is `Part of`.

## The ruling this implements

The seat ruled member by member, by the maintainer's criterion for this family: "does the mainstream have it? Yes ⇒ give it a reader. No ⇒ retire it on both faces." Each member below was measured unread before ruling: a non-test grep, plus a runtime probe through the real `SchemaRenderer` and registry that drew the same markup with the member set and unset. Nothing in this repository or in ObjectStack authors any of them outside test fixtures. The phase-1 report on the card carries the measurement and the citations.

On the TypeScript face each member becomes a `?: never` tombstone, so `tsc` refuses it by name. On the zod face it becomes a retirement tombstone, refused by name with the reason and what to write instead (`RETIRED (objectui#11434, ADR-0049) — KEY on OWNER had no reader: … Instead: …`). An element type that typed only a retired member leaves both faces and the exports.

## Members retired, each with its migration line

| Member | Faces before | Migration (as in the changeset) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `DataModelDesignerSchema.autoLayout` | TS declared; zod unmirrored (`UnmirroredDeclared`) | delete it; auto-layout is an action, use the toolbar's Auto Layout button |
| `ReportDesignerSchema.previewMode` | TS declared; zod unmirrored (`UnmirroredDeclared`) | delete it; for a chrome-free, non-editable layout author `readOnly: true`, `showToolbar: false`, `showPropertyPanel: false` |
| `DesignerComponent.parentId` | both, mirrored | delete it; nest the child in its parent's `children` array, the tree's one spelling |
| `DataModelRelationship.onUpdate` (**seat override: retire**) | both, mirrored | delete it; the platform's relationship contract has no update behaviour |
| `BPMNNode.serviceEndpoint` | both, mirrored | delete it; there is nothing to configure in its place (a service task references an implementation, not a URL) |
| `ObjectDefinition.relationships` (+ `ObjectDefinitionRelationship`: `relatedObject`, `type`, `label`, `foreignKey`) | both, mirrored | delete it; declare the relationship on the referencing field: in the designer, a `lookup` field whose `referenceTo` names the related object (in `@objectstack/spec` metadata, a `lookup` / `master_detail` field whose `reference` names it) |
| `DesignerFieldDefinition.validationRules` (+ `DesignerValidationRule`: `type`, `value`, `message`) | both, mirrored | delete it; put bounds on the field as `min` / `max` / `minLength` / `maxLength`, other rules in the object's `validations` |

**Removed exports.** `ObjectDefinitionRelationship` and `DesignerValidationRule` leave the `@object-ui/types` root barrel. `ObjectDefinitionRelationshipSchema` and `DesignerValidationRuleSchema` leave `@object-ui/types/zod`.

**The component face agrees.** `DataModelDesignerProps.autoLayout` and `ReportDesignerProps.previewMode` are removed from `@object-ui/plugin-designer`; neither was read. The `data-model-designer` registration no longer publishes `autoLayout` among its `inputs`; `check:component-surface-parity` had reported it as outside (spec ∪ renderer reads). The package README's `DataModelDesigner` example no longer passes `autoLayout`.

**Renderers are untouched.** Every retired member was ignored at render before this change and still is. What moves is the verdict.

## Ledger movement (`zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`, same PR as its members)

| Figure | Before | After | Why |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `UnmirroredDeclared` | 8 entries / 20 keys | 6 entries / 18 keys | the `DataModelDesignerSchema` (`autoLayout`) and `ReportDesignerSchema` (`previewMode`) entries close: each key is now a tombstone on both faces, and a tombstone is a mirrored member |
| its LOCAL half | 5 / 6 | 3 / 4 | the same two entries; the SPEC-DERIVED half (3 / 14) did not move |
| union of the two unmirrored ledgers | 13 pairs (8 + 5) | 11 pairs (6 + 5) | the closed entries were in `UnmirroredDeclared` alone |
| `EXPECTED_MIRROR_PAIRS` | 192 | 190 | the `ObjectDefinitionRelationshipSchema` and `DesignerValidationRuleSchema` pairs left the registry with their types |

`ProcessDesignerSchema`'s `lanes` / `version` entry stays: they are ruled READ, and the reader PR mirrors them and closes it. Each move has its history sentence in the header, as the file's pins require.

Other pins that move with the members:
- `designer-zod-arms-10859.test.ts`: the full-document fixture no longer sets the retired members, and the `autoLayout` / `previewMode` omission rows become full key-set equality. The removed pairs' rows go.
- `check-designer-field-key-parity.test.ts`: the `relationships` pin now asserts that `ObjectDefinition.relationships` is the `?: never` tombstone. `group` / `sortOrder` stay on the UI model and all three stay off every object wire shape. The gate still lists `relationships` as UI-only, because a tombstone is a property signature.
- `ObjectManager.test.tsx` and `MetadataService.specKeyObjectPayload.test.ts`: the fixtures stop setting `relationships`. The wire-shape pins keep their strength through a `LEGACY` value cast from outside the type system, which still proves `toObjectPayload`'s explicit field list keeps the key off the wire.
- `component-docs-retired-handler-keys-7340.test.ts`: that census is name-shaped (`on*?: never`), so it now counts `DataModelRelationship.onUpdate`, recorded the way objectui#7068's `onSuccess` / `onFailure` were (30 total, `designer.ts` 1). It is a referential action, not a handler.
- New pin `designer-members-retired-11434.test.ts`, covering both faces of all seven members, the two removed exports, and lit controls.

## i18n census and the decision on the dead editor strings

`node scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs` lists `appDesigner.fieldDesigner.validationRules` and `appDesigner.fieldDesigner.addRule` as NEEDS-REVIEW. No call site asks for either; their only other footprint is the plugin-designer defaults map. They labelled an editor for the member this PR retires, which was never built. The card that once owned confirming that namespace, objectui#4730, is closed.

**Decision: retire both.** They are removed from the ten packs and from `DESIGNER_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS`, with a pin, `appDesigner-fieldDesigner-validation-rules-retired-11434.test.ts`, that checks absence in all ten packs and has a lit neighbour control. The defaults-map half stays held by `defaults-maps-mirror-en-pack.test.tsx` (objectui#4401). The other six NEEDS-REVIEW keys of that namespace are untouched.

## Changesets

- `@object-ui/types` **minor**, with a BREAKING (authoring) banner and one migration line per member (`11434-designer-members-retired.md`)
- `@object-ui/plugin-designer` minor: the removed props and registration input (`11434-plugin-designer-retired-props.md`)
- `@object-ui/i18n` patch: the two labels (`11434-i18n-validation-rule-labels.md`)
- `@object-ui/app-shell` patch: comments only in `MetadataService` (`11434-app-shell-relationships-note.md`)
- Dated notes on two pending changesets this release makes false: `10859-designer-zod-arms.md`, whose "four unmirrored members … refused as unrecognized keys" sentence no longer holds for two of them, and `10719-retire-phase35-validation-types.md`, whose sentence that "`DesignerValidationRule` stay[s] exported" no longer holds for it. This follows the dated-note shape objectui#10859 batch 8 landed. `check-changeset-overwrite` reports both edits, report-only by design.

## Evidence (head `91a824298`; patch rounds 1 and 2 at `6b5012446` / `97a16bccb` below)

- **Patch round 2 (`97a16bccb`, prose only, contract review `5947291305`, seat order `5947305312`).** The `ObjectDefinition.relationships` prescription paired a designer-face key with a spec-face type: `referenceTo` on a `master_detail` field, which neither face can author. `DESIGNER_FIELD_TYPES` has no `master_detail`, and the spec spells the key `reference`. Fixed in the `designer.ts` Instead line, the zod refusal message, the changeset migration line and this table row: in the designer, a `lookup` field with `referenceTo`; in `@objectstack/spec` metadata, a `lookup` / `master_detail` field with `reference`. A grep of this PR's diff for other face-mixing prescriptions found two `@ts-expect-error` descriptions in the new pin, aligned the same way. The docblock's spec sentence and the changeset's TypeScript example are unchanged. Re-run through `os-verify-lock`: `designer-members-retired-11434.test.ts` (`18 passed`) && `check:changeset-claims` && `tsc --noEmit` + `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` for `@object-ui/types`, chained, VERDICT command-exit 0.

- **Patch round 1 (`6b5012446`, prose only, REWORK `5946901058`).** I measured through the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0. `ObjectSchema.safeParse` with an object-level `relationships: []` answers `unrecognized_keys`: "Unrecognized key(s) on this object: `relationships`. Until this shape was closed these were dropped silently on the PARSE path …". `FieldSchema.safeParse` with `validationRules: []` answers "Unrecognized key(s) on this field: `validationRules`. Until this shape was closed these were dropped silently …". Neither carries named guidance. The controls do: object-level `validationRules` gets "Did you mean `validationRules` → `validations`?" and field-level `referenceTo` gets "→ `reference`". So every sentence this PR writes about the spec now says "refuses it as an unrecognized key", not "by name". Those sentences are in the `designer.ts` docblocks, the two `designer.zod.ts` refusal messages, the `MetadataService.ts` comments this PR rewrote (including its `group` / `sortOrder` sentence, measured the same way), the new pin's header and the two changeset migration lines. The `serviceEndpoint` prescription is now "delete the key; there is nothing to configure in its place", in the TS docblock, the zod message and the changeset; `BPMNNode.properties` gets its reader in a later PR. Re-run through `os-verify-lock`: `vitest run packages/types/ packages/app-shell/src/services/MetadataService.specKeyObjectPayload.test.ts` → `Test Files 329 passed (329)`, `Tests 8767 passed`, VERDICT command-exit 0. Then the message pin `designer-members-retired-11434.test.ts` (`18 passed`), `check:changeset-claims`, and `tsc --noEmit` + `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` for `@object-ui/types`, chained with `&&`: VERDICT command-exit 0.

- **Test union**, root form via `os-verify-lock`. At `a5d1c2693`: `vitest run packages/types/ packages/plugin-designer/ packages/i18n/ packages/app-shell/src/services/` plus `defaults-maps-mirror-en-pack.test.tsx`, `registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859.test.ts`, and the `scripts/__tests__` files for designer-field-key-parity, doc-component-types, doc-links, doc-snippet-types, object-metadata-write-doors, readme-exports, doc-version-claims and unit-registry-absence-collision. Result: `Test Files 459 passed (459)`, `Tests 10965 passed | 13 skipped`, VERDICT command-exit 0. The 13 skips are the pre-existing `skipIf` in `formatting.dateOnlyZone-10866.test.ts`. `91a824298` changes only two changeset files, so the ratchet family and every test that reads `.changeset/` was re-run on it: `packages/types/` + the key-parity pin + those script tests gave `Test Files 353 passed (353)`, `Tests 9741 passed`, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- **Type-check after a closure build.** `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^... --filter=@object-ui/plugin-designer^... --filter=@object-ui/plugin-designer` passed, then `type-check` of `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/plugin-designer` and `@object-ui/app-shell`, joined with `&&`, plus `type-check:scripts`: VERDICT command-exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists the new and edited tests in their packages.
- **Ablation** (`ablation-replace.mjs` with an absolute-path EXIT/INT/TERM trap). Deleting the `autoLayout` retirement tombstone from `DataModelDesignerSchema` moved the anchor x1 → x0, blob `ff62eaf3` → `04d4fd87`. Runtime result: 2 red, both naming the member: "`autoLayout` is refused on the rendering face, at its own path, with the prescription" and "`autoLayout` is refused on the strict authoring face, at its own path". `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` went red at three rows: the new pin's zod row (`Property 'autoLayout' does not exist`), the batch-7 arms key-set row (`TS2344`), and the parity ledger (`'designer.zod.ts#DataModelDesignerSchema'` not assignable to `never`). Restored: blob equal to HEAD `ff62eaf3`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Gates**, each exit 0: `check-changeset-presence` ("29 source file(s) of 4 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 4 changeset(s)"), `changeset:check`, `check:changeset-claims`, `census:changeset-polarity`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:designer-field-key-parity` (`OK`), `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `docs:check-links`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:registry-bare-names`, `check:prompt-keys`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:self-import`, `check:phantom-deps`, `markdown-test-inputs --audit`. `check:doc-snippets`, `check:doc-examples` and `check:readme-exports` passed after the scoped build their own `--build-filter` names; packages that came in with the merge of `main` were not rebuilt for them. `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the diff: NOT GOVERNED.
- **ESLint, narrowed.** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 30 changed `.ts` / `.tsx` files gives, per file, the same error and warning counts as each base blob linted through `--stdin`. That includes one pre-existing `no-restricted-imports` error in `packages/types/src/index.ts`. The two new test files lint 0 / 0. `eslint.config.js` sets no `projectService` / `parserOptions.project`, so the diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict. The full `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- **NOT MEASURED: `check:sdui-registration-pins`.** Reason: it needs an `apps/console` build (exit 2, prerequisite not met). The diff adds or removes no registration; it drops one `inputs` row inside an existing one.
- **NOT MEASURED: `type-check:coverage`.** Reason: it is the whole-repo test compile, which CI runs. Every touched package's `tsconfig.test.json` is compiled above.

## Overlap

`packages/plugin-designer/src/index.tsx` is shared with objectui#10859 phase 2b. This PR removes only the `autoLayout` row from the `data-model-designer` registration's `inputs`. `main` was merged before opening (`a5d1c2693`, after objectui#11446 and objectui#11447 landed). Whichever lands second merges `main`.

## Acceptance notes

- `@object-ui/components`' `metadata-viewer` reads `obj?.validations ?? obj?.validationRules`, a consumer-side alias of a spelling the spec refuses on objects. It is unreachable through a public door, because the spec refuses `validationRules` at save. Noted, not filed, and not in this PR.
- The runtime render probes for PR 2 and PR 3 must not rely only on a gradient-valued style (happy-dom drops `radial-gradient` from serialized style), as the ruling records.
